Definition: Kirjathaim, the name of two placed in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Chedorlaomer smites the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim, the children of Reuben build Kirjathaim, and Joshua lists it in the mount of the valley. Two places share the name, one in Moab and one in Reuben.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same name marks a battlefield of kings and a town of Reuben's building, and the land remembers both.
